title: [docs] custom command documentation has wrong file redirect
body:
I found a bug in the docs for claude-code on the page https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/claude-code/tutorials#use-claude-as-a-unix-style-utility
`$ claude > /user:security-review`
Should be
`$ claude < /user:security-review`
in order to read in the command rather than overwrite it.
author: christian-oudard
